prerequisites: G1 passed with approved pilot terms
Eligibility and exclusions fixed before outcomes

merchantStudy.segmentHypothesis: Recurring specialist collectibles sellers on eBay using Android at a stable packing surface
merchantStudy.alternative: Used electronics only if qualified access and observed workflow economics are materially better
qualifyOn: willingness to report all eligible orders, failures and outcomes
baseline: Prior claims, carrier protection, tools and support labor
sequence: Uncoached first-use task; record interventions and misunderstanding
Natural unsupervised weekly use with all orders and skips recorded
Predeclared price/allowance and actual paid continuation
Observe second billing period only when it elapses
prohibitedSubstitutions: Founder demonstrations counted as unsupervised habit
Subscription UI counted as settled payment

reviewerStudy.assignment: Record a random seed and counterbalance ordinary/PackProof packets across comparable cases; avoid immediate same-case repetition
reviewerStudy.answerKey: Fixed issue-specific fact checklist with source offsets; no winner verdict
reviewerStudy.analysis: Raw counts, repeated case/reviewer structure and incomplete timings; no causal fraud-reduction claim

realClaimFollowup.duration: Until relevant disputes resolve, potentially after the cohort
realClaimFollowup.rule: Selected favorable cases inform learning, not an advertised win rate
